options.label: Open 4 Terminal windows on mini
options.description: From this mini-side claude session, fire osascript to spawn 4 Terminal.app windows on the Mini's desktop, each running the resume command. You'd interact with them on the Mini (or via screen-sharing into it).

options.label: Print SSH-ready resume lines for note
options.description: Give you 4 `ssh claudio1@macmini.local 'cd … && claude -r …'` lines so you can run/attach from your MacBook over SSH.

options.description: Forking has to happen wherever the SOURCE transcript lives — mini for all 5. To make siblings runnable on note we'd have to rsync the source bridge worktrees + project dirs to note first, then fork there with --into-main. Heavy.

options.label: Just print the mini-local lines
options.description: No action; you'll SSH/RDP to mini yourself and paste them.

Confirmed: I'm `claudio1@macmini.local` (mini). Your shell is `dtogni@Daniels-MacBook-Pro-2` (note). Local sessions are *files on the host where `fork` ran* — they don't sync between mini and note. So:

- The 4 bridge worktrees live at `/Users/claudio1/dev/ai-harness/.claude/worktrees/bridge-cse_…` **on mini**, not under your `/Users/dtogni/…` on note.
- The 4 sibling jsonls live at `/Users/claudio1/.claude/projects/…/<uuid>.jsonl` **on mini**.
- There is no way to `claude -r <uuid>` from note against them without first copying the jsonl (and likely rewriting `cwd`) over to note's `~/.claude/projects/<encoded>/`.
